q: The first transition element of the 3d series is ________. 2024
e: Scandium (atomic number 21) is the first transition element in the 3d series.

q: Iron and ________ are essential metals used in modern medicine. 2024
e: Iron and copper are essential metals required for biochemical processes in medicine.

q: Transition elements are significantly ________ reactive than Group I metals. 2024
e: Transition elements have higher ionization energy and stronger metallic bonds, making them less reactive than Group I metals.

q: The 3d transition series contain elements having the atomic numbers from ________. 2025
e: The 3d series spans ten elements from Scandium (atomic number 21) to Zinc (atomic number 30).

q: The highest oxidation state is ________ for manganese. 2025
e: Manganese has 7 valence electrons (3d⁵ 4s²), allowing a maximum oxidation state of +7.

q: The third series 5d transition elements run from lanthanum through ________. 2026
e: The 5d transition series ends with Mercury.

q: ________ is also used in artificial hip bone replacements, and eyeglass frames. 2024
e: Titanium is durable and biocompatible, making it suitable for joint replacements and eyeglass frames.

q: A transition metal catalyst, ________, is used in the hydrogenation of alkene. 2025
e: Nickel is commonly used as a catalyst to convert alkenes to alkanes via hydrogenation.

q: The number of unpaired electrons present in Cu+ ion is ________. 2025
e: Cu+ has the electronic configuration [Ar] 3d¹⁰, which contains zero unpaired electrons.

q: Yttrium and cadmium are ________ transition elements. 2025
e: Yttrium and cadmium belong to the d-block transition series.

q: The electronic configuration of Fe2+ ion is ________. (Given: 26Fe)
e: Iron loses its two 4s valence electrons to form Fe2+ with the configuration [Ar] 3d⁶.

q: The first row of the transition elements is in the ________ row of the Periodic Table.
e: The first row (3d series) of transition elements is located in Period 4 of the periodic table.

q: Transition elements exhibit variable valency because they release electrons from ________ orbitals. 2025
e: Electrons in both (n-1)d and ns subshells have similar energies and can participate in bonding.

q: ________ is also used in artificial hip bone replacements and eyeglass frames. 2025
e: Titanium is light, strong, and corrosion-resistant, making it ideal for medical implants.

q: ________ pair of transition metals of the 3d series do not show a variable oxidation state. 2025
e: Scandium only exhibits +3 and Zinc only exhibits +2 oxidation state.

q: The essential electronic configuration of Zn2+ is ________.
e: Zinc loses two 4s electrons upon ionization, leaving a stable filled 3d¹⁰ configuration.

q: The 3d series transition elements have ________. 2025
a: low melting points and boiling points
e: Transition metals in the 3d series possess characteristic catalytic properties.

q: In the first series transition metal elements, the ________ orbital is the outermost orbital. 2025
e: The 4s orbital has a higher principal quantum number (n=4) and is the outermost shell.

q: Many transition elements and their compounds act as good ________ for specific reactions. 2025
e: Transition metals serve as catalysts due to their variable oxidation states.

q: In 3d transition series, the element which has the lowest melting point is ________. 2025
e: Zinc has a filled d-shell, weakening its metallic bonds and giving it the lowest melting point in the 3d series.

q: In stainless steel, iron is mixed with ________. 2025
e: Stainless steel is primarily an alloy of iron, nickel, and chromium.

q: Transition metals usually have their ________ oxidation states in compounds with fluorine. 2025
e: Fluorine's extreme electronegativity stabilizes transition metals in higher oxidation states.

q: The essential electronic configuration of 27Co is ________. 2026
e: Cobalt (atomic number 27) has the valence electron configuration 4s² 3d⁷.

q: In the environment, lead primarily exists in the ________ oxidation states. 2026
e: Lead typically exists in +2 and +4 oxidation states.

q: ________ steel is extremely strong and is used for railway tracks. 2025
e: Manganese steel is tough and highly resistant to impact, suitable for railway tracks.

q: ________ is used to reduce the aromatics and improve the octane rating in gasoline. 2025
e: Manganese additives improve fuel octane ratings.

q: ________ is used in artificial hip bone replacements, and eyeglass frames. 2025
e: Titanium's high bio-compatibility makes it suitable for hip replacements and eyeglass frames.

q: ________ is used to reduce the aromatics and improve the octane rating in gasoline. 2026
e: Manganese is used to reduce aromatics and increase octane rating in gasoline.

q: In general, transition metals do not ________ readily in the atmosphere. 2026
e: Transition metals are generally resistant to atmospheric corrosion.

q: Copper is used as an electrical wire because it is a good ________ of electricity. 2026
e: Copper has high electrical conductivity, making it an excellent electrical conductor.
